acceptance: A BM25 ranker over the knowledge-base corpus, fused with the kbgraph neighbour list by reciprocal rank fusion (k=60), sits behind research.KB, selected by configuration, at stage shadow.
In shadow, each plan recall runs both rankers and records both result lists; the plan uses the current ranker.
The switch to the new ranker is a data rule at a boundary: it beats the baseline on recall@5 and MRR on the gold set by a recorded margin.
fix: Implement a native Go BM25 plus RRF ranker behind research.KB, run it in shadow beside the current ranker, and flip it only on a measured gain.
summary: The qmd dossier recommends taking the hybrid-retrieval ideas of tobi/qmd (BM25, reciprocal rank fusion of several ranked lists) natively in Go, without its LLM expansion and rerank models, which would be LLM calls outside the bridge, and without its 2 GB model download.
title: A native BM25 plus RRF knowledge-base ranker runs in shadow beside the current one
